text:
Nora: Heads-up — linkcheck failed on staging after the MkDocs -> Docusaurus migration. Seems to be an anchor slug change plus a couple of relative image paths that broke.

DevBot: Linkcheck failed in CI build #402: https://ci.redwood/402 :warning:

Nora: Excerpt from the logs:
```
WARN Broken fragment: /guides/retrieval.md#setup -> fragment not found
WARN Missing file: ../assets/diagrams/retrieval-arch.svg -> 404
```

Ben T.: I think during conversion the H2 `Setup` got expanded to `Setup for retrieval` and now slugifies to `#setup-for-retrieval`. Old link pointed at `#setup`.

Carlos: Confirmed. Ran `rg "retrieval.md#setup"` and got two hits: tutorials/retrieval-quickstart.md and examples/go/retrieval_example.go.

Priya: The svg was moved to `static/img/retrieval-arch.svg` to match docusaurus layout but the doc still references it relatively. We should use `/img/retrieval-arch.svg` in the MDX.

Nora: Proposed fixes: update the two refs to the new slug, update the Go example link, and fix image path to `/img/retrieval-arch.svg`. Also add an explicit short id on the heading to preserve old external links: `## Setup for retrieval {#setup}`.

Ben T.: I prefer updating refs and adding the short id at the same time. That handles both internal and external links.

Carlos: I'll patch the Go example too so the SDK snippet links into the right section. While here, should we add a tiny unit that validates fragments for changed files in PRs?

Priya: I've drafted a small shell script to check changed md/mdx files for fragment references and verify targets exist. I can include it as a test in the PR.

DevBot: Checklist suggestion:
- [ ] Update references to `#setup-for-retrieval` or add `{#setup}` on target
- [ ] Fix image path to `/img/retrieval-arch.svg`
- [ ] Update SDK examples and Go snippet links
- [ ] Add `tests/check_fragments.sh` and run locally
- [ ] Run `pnpm docs:build && pnpm docs:linkcheck` before pushing

Nora: I'll open a small PR with the three fixes + script. Will run the checks locally first.

Nora: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/902 — includes link updates, image path fix, explicit heading id, updated examples/go/retrieval_example.go, and `tests/check_fragments.sh`.

DevBot: PR 902 — linkcheck job queued in CI.

Carlos: Thanks Nora. One note: when you update the Go example, please keep the comment that points readers to the guide — update the URL there too.

Ben T.: Ran `pnpm docs:linkcheck` locally against the branch; all fragments present. Added a tiny test that fails if a referenced fragment is missing.

DevBot: CI for PR 902 — linkcheck passed :white_check_mark:. Build green.

Priya: Merged. Staging linkcheck is now green, verified on staging site.

Nora: Great — I'll add a short section in the migration guide about heading slug differences and image canonicalization under `/static/img`.

Carlos: Filing an infra ticket for a pre-commit hook that runs the quick fragment script on changed files. Saves us a roundtrip.

Ben T.: Nice. Closing thread. :tada:
